final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - stats.average_share AS above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN stats WHERE s.share > stats.average_share ORDER BY above_average DESC LIMIT 10
